I had a very comfortable stay at Anchorage Guest House. The place is well-maintained, peaceful, and homely.

Special respect to Capt. Vishal Khanna, who despite being physically challenged now, continues to extend his warmth and hospitality to all mariners and guests. As a fellow seafarer, I deeply admire his resilience and dedication — it is our duty as mariners to stand by and support him.

A heartfelt thanks also to Abha Ma’am, who takes excellent care of everyone here and ensures that all guests feel at home.

Highly recommended for mariners and their families visiting Delhi.

Spacious Rooms, But Poor Maintenance Ruins the Experience

Stayed at Captain Vishal Khanna’s Anchorage Hotel and unfortunately had a disappointing experience. While the rooms are quite spacious and the location is convenient and well-connected, the overall maintenance is severely lacking.

The room door lock didn’t function properly, which raised serious safety concerns. The bathroom was in bad shape — the shower and fittings were clogged with scale and mineral deposits, making it unpleasant and difficult to use. The drainage was poor, and the bathroom remained wet and smelly most of the time.

There were frequent power outages during the stay, and even when the power was on, the AC barely worked and didn’t cool the room at all.

This place has potential, but unless the basic facilities and cleanliness are significantly improved, I wouldn’t recommend it
